edu.cnu.mdi.sim.SimulationContext

Packages that use SimulationContext
Package
Description
edu.cnu.mdi.sim
UI-independent simulation lifecycle abstractions and a background execution engine whose listener callbacks are delivered on the Swing event thread.

edu.cnu.mdi.sim.ga
Generic, maximization-oriented genetic-algorithm contracts and simulation support.

Generic simulated annealing for minimizing finite-valued energy functions.

    Called when cancellation is requested via SimulationEngine.requestCancel().

    Called exactly once when the engine reaches a terminal outcome.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onDone(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called when the engine ends normally (reaches SimulationState.TERMINATED).
    default void
    SimulationListener.onFail(SimulationContext ctx, Throwable error)
    Called when the engine fails (reaches SimulationState.FAILED).
    default void
    SimulationListener.onInit(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called after the engine transitions to SimulationState.INITIALIZING.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onMessage(SimulationContext ctx, String message)
    Called for status/log messages intended for UI display.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onPause(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called when the engine enters SimulationState.PAUSED.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onProgress(SimulationContext ctx, ProgressInfo progress)
    Called for progress updates (indeterminate or determinate).
    default void
    SimulationListener.onReady(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called when initialization completes and the engine reaches SimulationState.READY.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onRefresh(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called for a graphics refresh/update event.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onResume(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called when the engine resumes from SimulationState.PAUSED back to SimulationState.RUNNING.
    default void
    SimulationListener.onRun(SimulationContext ctx)
    Called when the engine begins execution (enters SimulationState.RUNNING).
    default void
    SimulationListener.onStateChange(SimulationContext ctx, SimulationState from, SimulationState to, String reason)
    Called on every state transition.
    default void
    Simulation.shutdown(SimulationContext ctx)
    Shutdown hook called on the simulation thread when the engine is terminating (normal completion, stop, cancel, or failure).
    boolean
    Simulation.step(SimulationContext ctx)
    Execute a single step of the simulation.

  • Uses of SimulationContext in edu.cnu.mdi.sim.ga

    Methods in edu.cnu.mdi.sim.ga with parameters of type SimulationContext
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    GeneticAlgorithmSimulation.init(SimulationContext ctx)
    Seeds the RNG, builds the initial population via GAProblem.initialPopulation(int, Random), evaluates and tracks the best individual, and resets the generation counter to zero.
    boolean
    GeneticAlgorithmSimulation.step(SimulationContext ctx)
    Advances the GA by one generation: builds an offspring pool via selection/crossover/mutation, evaluates it, replaces the population via ReplacementOperator.replace(List, List, double[], double[], Random), and re-evaluates the resulting generation.
